html:
/* Template:TreePortrait/styles.css - a portrait with a caption at the top left of a page. The JPG has square corners, so the
   corners are rounded here. Headings start below the picture (clear: left). */
.aa-tp {
	float: left;
	margin: 4px 22px 14px 0;
	text-align: center;
}
.aa-tp img {
	display: block;
	height: auto;
	border-radius: 8px;
	box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #5a5040, 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
}
.aa-tp-cap {
	margin-top: 6px;
	color: var(--color-subtle, #54595d);
	font-size: 0.78em;
	letter-spacing: 0.06em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}
.mw-heading {
	clear: left;
}
